llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文为临床回顾性研究，关注翻修全髋关节置换术后股骨柄下沉的风险因素，未涉及生物力学建模或有限元分析，与用户研究方向不相关。
llm.why_not_core: No biomechanics modeling, no finite element analysis, no quantification of stress shielding or micromotion, and no intact vs implanted femur comparison.

summary_zh.motivation: 明确翻修术中模块化锥形股骨柄下沉的临床风险因素
summary_zh.method: 回顾性分析翻修全髋置换病例，采用多变量回归确定独立风险因素
summary_zh.result: 下沉率显著，与骨缺损程度和初始稳定性相关
summary_zh.validation: 临床病例验证，多变量回归分析

summary_en.motivation: To identify clinical risk factors for subsidence of modular tapered femoral stems in revision total hip arthroplasty.
summary_en.method: A retrospective study of revision THA cases was conducted, using multivariate regression to determine independent risk factors for stem subsidence.
summary_en.result: Subsidence was significantly associated with the severity of bone defect and initial implant stability.
summary_en.validation: Clinical validation through retrospective analysis of patient outcomes.
